question: Why is the habituated knowledge-possessor declared liberating?
premises: it was said in Malini Tantra
the wise declare the habituated knowledge-possessor liberating
inference: liberation is attributed to the wise possessor of habituated knowledge
plain_english: As said in the Malini Tantra, considering one joined with knowledge, the wise declare the possessor of habituated knowledge to be liberating.
